channel.title: AirothyServer
channel.description: Auto-update feed for the Airothy macOS server.

item.description:
First stable release of Airothy for Mac. Use your iPhone as a wireless trackpad and keyboard for your Mac.

  • Trackpad with the full gesture set: pointer, clicks, scrolling, pinch to zoom, drag and drop, and three-finger swipes for Mission Control and Spaces.
  • Full-screen Mac keyboard with modifiers, function keys, and input-source switching.
  • Secure pairing with a 6-digit code or QR code; commands are authenticated end to end.
  • Sleep and wake the Mac's display from your iPhone.
  • Localized in 8 languages.

Changes since 1.0.0-beta.4: fixed onboarding titles truncating in some languages, and the welcome screen's "learn how to use" link wrapping in German and French.

item.title: 1.0.0-beta.4
item.description:
Fourth beta of AirothyServer — remote display sleep/wake and a refreshed pairing screen.

  • Sleep the Mac's screen and wake it from your iPhone — the sleep button can now turn off the display while keeping the Mac connected, so touching the trackpad wakes it back. Choose "Sleep Display" (default) or "Sleep Mac" in the iPhone app's settings.
  • Redesigned pairing screen with one-time-code boxes, auto-submit, and a shake on an incorrect code.
  • Fixed a QR-code pairing issue caused by a double-submit.

This release updates the wire protocol to v4 — update the Airothy iPhone app to the matching beta as well. Existing pairings are preserved.

item.title: 1.0.0-beta.3
item.description:
Third beta of AirothyServer — localization release.

  • Full localization across 8 languages (English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Arabic).
  • Pairing and disconnect errors now appear in the iPhone's language instead of the Mac's.
  • Fixed several strings that always showed in English regardless of system language.

Backwards-compatible with existing paired iPhones — no re-pairing needed.

item.title: 1.0.0-beta.2
item.description:
Second beta of AirothyServer.

What's fixed

  • Pairing between iPhone and Mac now persists reliably across server restarts.

If you previously paired an iPhone, you'll need to re-pair once after this update: remove the Mac entry on the iPhone, then pair again. After this one re-pair, future updates keep the pairing intact.

item.title: 1.0.0-beta.1
item.description:
First beta of AirothyServer — control your Mac from your iPhone.

  • Pair your iPhone with your Mac and use it as a trackpad and keyboard.
  • 3-finger swipes for Mission Control and Spaces.
  • Function-row keys, media controls, and modifiers.
  • In-app auto-updates (you'll get a prompt when the next build ships).
